method: AUDIT IN -> FINDINGS -> REMEDIATION -> VERIFICATION -> AUDIT OUT

layers.name: Frontend foundations
evidence: Candidate 1608968 retains the tested desktop/mobile first-use UI and adds native radio semantics plus roving keyboard focus for onboarding choices. The complete release gate passed, and the final Preview uses the same verified concierge asset hashes with fail-closed sign-in.
layers.testCommand: npm run release:gate && npm run test:concierge
layers.failureDetails: A full automated WCAG/Lighthouse artifact, signed-user flow, and Production behavior remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Capture a full automated accessibility and performance artifact, then repeat bounded route, console, responsive, and signed-user checks after Production approval.

layers.name: APIs and backend logic
evidence: API security, resilience, idempotency, output-boundary, and serverless import tests pass locally across 41 routes. Exact candidate 1aded9c on protected Preview dpl_E2D1cHiTdHg9Si2qhc1frrYpe1qW returned liveness 200, readiness 503 fail-closed, app configuration 200, and three bounded discovery-canary 200s. Each canary attempted and completed eight representative sources across all four ATS providers out of the 37-source catalog in 1.406-1.718 seconds. Production is not the candidate artifact.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:web-release && npm run security:live-boundary
layers.failureDetails: Production is not the candidate artifact and signed-user behavior remains unknown.
layers.remediation: Configure an isolated signed-beta environment, run safe signed-user Preview probes, and repeat complete bounded Production acceptance only after release approval.

layers.name: Database and storage
evidence: Dedicated Neon Free staging now runs the exact canonical migration on PostgreSQL 17.11. Live inspection verified 20/20 RLS and forced-RLS tables, policies on all 20 tables, zero FOR ALL policies, zero client-role table privileges, and 19/19 adversarial pgTAP cases. A synthetic snapshot restored into a separate branch and cleanup returned the project to one branch, zero snapshots, and zero fixture rows. Preview-only configuration is branch scoped and Sensitive; Production was untouched.
layers.failureDetails: Persistent staging database isolation and managed restore are verified. Private object storage, signed-user application-to-database persistence, Production authoritative-store migration, and Production recovery remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Exercise the signed-user persistence path in isolated Preview, implement and verify private object storage, then review an explicit authoritative-store migration and Production recovery plan before any Production database activation.

layers.name: Authentication and permissions
evidence: Opaque signed-session, revocation, tenant ownership, admin-role, entitlement, and consent tests pass locally. Exact Preview dpl_E2D1cHiTdHg9Si2qhc1frrYpe1qW verified a server-only readiness check exposes only restoreAccessAvailable=false. A value-blind Production audit found zero of five consent-control names and zero of eight controlled-beta names present; actual values and signed-user behavior remain unavailable and unclaimed.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/user-session-test.mjs && node scripts/api-security-test.mjs && node scripts/clerk-identity-test.mjs && node scripts/app-config-test.mjs
layers.failureDetails: Actual signed-user creation/revocation, identity-provider configuration, and cross-tenant staging behavior remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Configure the isolated signed-beta runtime, then verify a least-privilege staging account matrix, email-code session creation, revocation, admin denial, and tenant-crossing denial using synthetic accounts and the exact release commit.

layers.name: Hosting and deployment
evidence: Clean release candidate 70736f3 passed the complete release gate and clean-candidate preflight. Exact protected Preview dpl_9DLBhVkEo9JAvr8uN2kGBpqxJyUv verified route behavior, the representative discovery canary, bounded liveness behavior, and content-free provider logs. Fresh Production parity still fails for the four concierge artifacts and Production lacks the candidate health routes.
layers.testCommand: npm run release:gate && npm run test:deployment-output && npm run security:asset-parity
layers.failureDetails: Production serves a different artifact and remote CI for the candidate is unknown.
layers.remediation: Push the reviewed candidate, require green remote CI, resolve Critical infrastructure gates, then obtain explicit Production approval before promotion and bounded acceptance checks.

layers.name: Cloud and compute
evidence: Function duration, isolation, spend, bounded-concurrency, and fail-closed contracts pass locally. Candidate 70736f3 adds a strict clean-release/exact-Preview evidence contract for separately approved synthetic signed-user latency, provider-unit, quota, cost, and failure-containment results. The latest three Preview canaries completed in 0.987-1.485 seconds. No signed-user exercise or quota/cost proof exists.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && npm run test:capacity-probe
layers.failureDetails: Function/account quota ceilings, approved cost ceilings, cold starts, signed-user saturation, and vendor failure behavior remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Approve explicit function/account quota, queue, latency, provider-unit, and cost ceilings, then perform the bounded synthetic signed-user dependency-failure and saturation exercise and validate its artifact.

layers.name: CI/CD and version control
evidence: Implementation commit 307e48d hardens the Node 24 workflows with SHA-pinned actions, locked installs, bounded jobs, minimal permissions, concurrency controls, and non-persisted checkout credentials. Commit 0510756 adds a separate bounded high/critical production dependency-audit job. The local CI policy test and complete release gate pass; npm audit found zero vulnerabilities across 167 production dependencies (181 total dependency entries).
layers.testCommand: npm run test:ci-policy && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run release:gate
layers.failureDetails: The hardened workflow and dependency audit have not yet executed in GitHub because push and review were not authorized.
layers.remediation: Obtain explicit push and review authorization, require both Production Readiness Gate jobs as branch checks, and verify the remote CI results before release review.

layers.name: Security and row-level security
evidence: The exact canonical migration is applied to dedicated Neon staging. Live catalog inspection verified RLS and forced RLS on all 20 Job Agent tables, operation-specific policies on all tables, no FOR ALL policies, and zero PUBLIC, anonymous, or authenticated table privileges. The adversarial pgTAP suite passed 19/19, including cross-tenant reads, writes, relationships, ownership transfer, delete, and invalid tenant context.
layers.failureDetails: The signed-user Preview application-to-database identity write and Production database boundary remain unverified; provider-specific advisor output was not retained.
layers.remediation: Run a synthetic signed-user Preview persistence check, retain content-free provider advisor results, and repeat the tenant matrix before any Production database activation.

layers.name: Rate limiting
evidence: Durable tenant/global rate limits, hashed partitions, fail-closed configuration, and local regression tests exist. Candidate 70736f3 adds a verifier that requires durable tenant/global limit observation, valid retry semantics, tenant-key isolation, zero bypasses, and fail-closed behavior during backend unavailability. It has not accepted a live signed-user artifact.
layers.failureDetails: Current deployed limits, alert thresholds, and behavior under concurrent tenants are not verified.
layers.remediation: Approve and run the bounded synthetic signed-user exercise, then validate the redacted artifact; do not infer runtime proof from the local contract.

layers.name: Caching and CDN
evidence: Preview verified concierge and API Cache-Control no-store, strict concierge CSP/security headers, and homepage public max-age=300 with stale-while-revalidate=60.
layers.failureDetails: Production headers, invalidation behavior, error-route caching, and authenticated cross-user cache isolation remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Repeat header checks after production approval and add signed-user cache-isolation and error-route scenarios.

layers.name: Load balancing and scaling
evidence: Provider bounds and circuit breakers pass local tests. Exact protected Preview dpl_9DLBhVkEo9JAvr8uN2kGBpqxJyUv passed a GET-only body-free liveness probe: 10/10 HTTP 200 at concurrency two, p50 106 ms and p95/max 145 ms. Candidate 70736f3 adds a strict verifier requiring zero starvation and cross-tenant interference, bounded queue depth/wait, explicit backpressure, zero drops/duplicate leases, drain, dependency containment, approved ceilings, and cleanup. The signed-user exercise has not run.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/public-ats-discovery-test.mjs && npm run test:resilience && npm run test:capacity-probe
layers.failureDetails: Quota and cost ceilings, signed-user fairness, queue throughput/backpressure, saturation, regional failover, and Production capacity remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Approve quota, queue, latency, provider-unit, and cost ceilings, then separately authorize and run the synthetic signed-user fairness, backpressure, saturation, and dependency-failure exercise; do not infer Production capacity from liveness or the verifier.

layers.name: Error tracking and logs
evidence: Content-free structured events, admin-only health/dependency routes, worker heartbeat state, audit-chain tests, and operator-alert queues exist. Exact Preview dpl_9DLBhVkEo9JAvr8uN2kGBpqxJyUv produced 16 allowlisted expected log records with no content-bearing or unexpected record. Production alert ownership/delivery remains unconfigured and unverified.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/job-agent-operator-alert-test.mjs && npm run test:preview-log-evidence
layers.failureDetails: No approved receiver, alert delivery receipt, retained log destination, dashboard SLO, or on-call acknowledgement was verified.
layers.remediation: Name owners and approve the exact destination, retention, and acknowledgement window; then verify receiver-side synthetic alert acknowledgement and any approved log retention/dashboard.

layers.name: Availability and recovery
evidence: Neon staging retains six hours of restore history. A manual snapshot of one synthetic row restored into a distinct branch; readback succeeded, restore compute became ready in 1,692 ms, and cleanup left one main branch, zero snapshots, and zero synthetic rows. Application retries and recovery tests continue to pass locally.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/encrypted-record-recovery-test.mjs && npm run test:database-evidence
layers.failureDetails: Managed staging restore is verified, but Production still uses its existing authoritative runtime. Production recovery, approved RPO/RTO, alert delivery, private-object recovery, and full relational integrity reconciliation remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Define approved RPO/RTO and alert ownership, finish private-storage recovery, migrate the authoritative store through an explicit reviewed plan, and then run a bounded Production-equivalent recovery exercise without touching live candidate data.
